fact: RTI used drone-labelled training data to build satellite crop-type models with over 90% accuracy for the Konni Irrigation Perimeter, mapping crop shifts between the 2023 and 2025 seasons, and engaged the agriculture ministry, ONAHA and AGRHYMET as local institutions.
title: High Frequency Monitoring: The Use of Drone Imagery to Generate Training Data for Crop Modeling in the Konni Irrigation Perimeter 2019-2025 Final Report
